name: Plagued Lands
summary: Corruption is spreading through Darkshore, where Tharnariun Treetender hopes to save the afflicted wildlife. He asks travelers to calm a rabid thistle bear with an enchanted relic and bring it back alive.

sections.title: A Blight on the Wilderness
sections.body: A creeping sickness twists Darkshore’s beasts into maddened, aggressive versions of themselves. Thistle bears suffer most, their rabid frenzy threatening travelers and the coast’s fragile balance. Night elf sentinels often answer with steel, while druids seek to understand the sickness and heal its cause.

sections.title: Tharnariun's Hope
sections.body: Tharnariun Treetender refuses to kill the corrupted beasts without first trying to save them. He made a trap called Tharnariun’s Hope. Set on the forest floor, its soothing light briefly calms a raging thistle bear. Pacified, the bear follows the traveler back to Tharnariun’s outpost for study.

sections.title: Tragic Medicine
sections.body: When an infected bear reaches camp, Tharnariun tries to purge its sickness with restorative magic. His first attempt ends in disaster: cleansing energies overwhelm the weakened animal, and it collapses and dies. The failure shows how deeply the dark plague has taken hold.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Plagued Lands?
faq.answer: Tharnariun Treetender, a night elf druid in Auberdine, gives this task. He seeks a cure for Darkshore’s afflicted wildlife.

faq.q: What is the objective of Plagued Lands?
aliases: what to do in plagued lands
faq.answer: Use Tharnariun’s Hope to trap and calm a Rabid Thistle Bear in Darkshore, then lead it back to Tharnariun alive.

faq.q: What happens to the bear when you bring it back?
faq.answer: Tharnariun tries to cleanse the bear with healing magic, but the sickness has advanced too far. The strain overwhelms it, and it dies after the treatment.

faq.q: What item do you use to capture the bear?
faq.answer: Tharnariun provides Tharnariun’s Hope, an enchanted trap whose calming light pacifies the enraged bear so it will follow you.
After Plagued Lands comes Cleansing of the Infected, followed by Tharnariun’s Hope.

faq.q: Why are the thistle bears rabid?
aliases: why are bears sick in darkshore
faq.answer: A creeping plague is spreading through Darkshore, poisoning local wildlife and driving the thistle bears into mindless aggression.

angles.text: As a night elf, seeing Darkshore’s native flora and fauna decay into rabid madness is an affront to Cenarius and the balance of nature you are sworn to protect.
As a druid, you share Tharnariun’s grief as nature falls to corruption. The bear’s tragic loss shows how deeply the disease has spread through the land.
As an Alliance traveler crossing northern Kalimdor, you face untamed corruption pressing against the borders of settled lands.
